beginner-turn.title: A right-face turn
beginner-turn.caption: R turns the right face clockwise when you look straight at that face. Reset to watch again.

beginner-cross.title: Bring an edge down
beginner-cross.caption: White is underneath; green is at the front. F2 brings the white-green edge to its matching center.

beginner-corner.title: Insert a white corner
beginner-corner.caption: White is underneath. The white-green-orange corner goes into the front-right slot.

beginner-middle-right.title: Insert an edge to the right
beginner-middle-right.caption: White stays underneath. The green-orange edge starts above the green center and moves right.
beginner-middle-right.setup: F' U' F U R U R' U'
beginner-middle-right.algorithm: U R U' R' U' F' U F

beginner-middle-left.title: Insert an edge to the left
beginner-middle-left.caption: White stays underneath. The green-red edge starts above the green center and moves left.
beginner-middle-left.setup: F U F' U' L' U' L U
beginner-middle-left.algorithm: U' L' U L U F U' F'

beginner-yellow-cross.title: Turn a line into a cross
beginner-yellow-cross.caption: Hold yellow on top, with the two yellow edge stickers in a left-to-right line.
beginner-yellow-cross.setup: F U R U' R' F'
beginner-yellow-cross.algorithm: F R U R' U' F'

beginner-yellow-edges.title: Place the yellow edges
beginner-yellow-edges.caption: Yellow is on top. The matching yellow edges are at the back and right; this sequence aligns the other two.
beginner-yellow-edges.setup: U' R U2 R' U' R U' R'
beginner-yellow-edges.algorithm: R U R' U R U2 R' U

beginner-yellow-corners.title: Cycle three corners
beginner-yellow-corners.caption: Yellow is on top. The front-right corner is already in its correct position, even if twisted.
beginner-yellow-corners.setup: L' U R U' L U R' U'
beginner-yellow-corners.algorithm: U R U' L' U R' U' L

beginner-orient-corners.title: Finish two twisted corners
beginner-orient-corners.caption: Keep yellow on top and green at the front throughout. Complete every four-move group; only U moves bring the next corner to the front-right.
beginner-orient-corners.setup: U D' R' D R D' R' D R D' R' D R D' R' D R U' D' R' D R D' R' D R
beginner-orient-corners.algorithm: R' D' R D R' D' R D U R' D' R D R' D' R D R' D' R D R' D' R D U'
